extracted.intended_audience: regulatory practitioners, VA program staff, attorneys, veterans, and members of the public seeking Title 38 CFR content
extracted.subtask_description: Locate and understand the content and legal status of Title 38 of the Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (eCFR), and use the site navigation and feedback mechanisms to find official published text or contact the issuing agency. This page is an entry/contents page listing parts within Title 38 and providing site-level guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: eCFR legal status
rubrics_metrics.description: The Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) is the official legal print publication containing the codification of the general and permanent rules published in the Federal Register. The Electronic Code of Federal Regulations (eCFR) is a continuously updated online version of the CFR. It is not an official legal edition of the CFR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For the most recent official published edition, view Title 38 on govinfo.gov; the published edition is updated annually and therefore may not include the most recent changes applied to the CFR. Learn more about the eCFR, its status, and the editorial process via the provided 'Learn more' links.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contacting issuing agency / feedback channels
rubrics_metrics.description: The Office of the Federal Register publishes documents on behalf of Federal agencies but does not have authority over their programs. If you have questions about the content, contact the agency that issued the document directly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the 'Website Feedback' button for comments/suggestions about www.ecfr.gov; use the 'Content Feedback' button for instructions on contacting the issuing agency about current content. For questions to the issuing agency, contact that agency directly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title 38 scope and part structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Title 38 is titled 'Pensions, Bonuses, and Veterans' Relief' and is organized into chapters and parts (e.g., Chapter I Department of Veterans Affairs, Parts 0–199 listed; Chapter II Armed Forces Retirement Home, Parts 200–299, etc.). The landing page lists parts and section ranges for Title 38 content (Parts 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, ... 79, 80, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the citations and headings or the search box to navigate: choosing an item from citations/headings brings you directly to the content; choosing an item from full text search results brings you to those results; pressing Enter in the search box will also bring you to search results. The page also offers links to view historical versions and to switch to a drafting site for drafting amendatory language.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhanced content and site tools
rubrics_metrics.description: The eCFR page provides enhanced content to give additional context (e.g., FR reference, timeline, developer tools, published edition links) and site features like subscribe, timeline, go-to-date, developer resources, and 'Using the eCFR Point-in-Time System' guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 'Subscribe' to receive updates for Title 38; use 'View the most recent official publication' links to access govinfo.gov; explore developer resources for programmatic access to the eCFR. The enhanced content is intended to provide supplementary context rather than replace the official published CFR.
